guide.title: How GitSeed Works
guide.subtitle: GitSeed turns software requirements (Seeds) into reviewed, merge-ready code by orchestrating AI agents across a 5-stage SDLC pipeline with human approval gates and spend guardrails.
guide.sdlcTitle: What is a Seed & The 5-Stage Pipeline
guide.sdlcSubtitle: A Seed is a single unit of engineering work (a feature, bugfix, or refactor) that moves left-to-right through five stages. Ideate, Plan, and Review can be turned off per project, and requesting changes at any gate sends a seed back to that stage's agent.

stages.ideateDesc: Clarifies the problem statement, scope, and constraints before planning begins.
stages.planDesc: Breaks the seed down into ordered implementation tasks and acceptance criteria.
stages.executeDesc: Runs coding agents inside isolated compute sandboxes to implement the approved tasks.
stages.reviewDesc: Evaluates the implementation against acceptance criteria, quality checks, and human review rules.
stages.mergeDesc: Finalizes approved work and merges changes into the target repository branch.
stages.ideateAgent: Analyzes the seed prompt and repository context to refine requirements and edge cases.
stages.ideateGate: Optional gate to confirm problem scope before decomposing into tasks.
stages.planAgent: Inspects target repositories and produces a structured task breakdown and implementation plan.
stages.planGate: You review and approve the proposed plan before code execution starts.
stages.planOut1: Ordered task list on the Seed
stages.executeAgent: Writes code, runs tests in a sandboxed runner, and streams live run logs and token spend.
stages.executeGate: Automatic or gated transition once tasks and test suites succeed within budget.
stages.executeOut2: Run logs, token metrics & cost tracking
stages.reviewAgent: Audits diffs, checks test results, and summarizes findings for reviewers.
stages.reviewGate: Enforces minimum approver role and distinct-reviewer rules; supports Request Changes.
stages.mergeAgent: Verifies all upstream gates and prepares the final merge operation.
stages.mergeGate: Final sign-off gate (typically Maintainer or Admin) before marking the Seed Merged.

guide.gettingStartedSubtitle: Stage policies, local Docker compute, and default agents are pre-configured. Complete these steps to start running seeds.

steps.backendsDesc: Register a Git provider (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) and an Inference provider so your pre-configured agents can access repositories and LLMs.
steps.projectsDesc: Link one or more repositories from your Git backend, set a monthly spend budget, and add team members.
steps.seedsDesc: Write a requirement or bugfix, pick an autonomy level, and watch it progress from Ideate to Merge.

guide.modelTitle: How the Building Blocks Fit Together
guide.modelSubtitle: Four core concepts power every Seed from initial prompt to merged code.

model.projectsDesc: Projects link one or more Git repositories, configure sandbox & clean-room guardrails (project.sandbox_config.blocked_paths), track monthly budgets, manage team roles (Maintainer, Developer, Viewer), and optionally override organization stage policies.
model.agentsDesc: Agents combine an execution runtime (OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini, Grok Build) and LLM model with reusable Markdown Skills that codify your team's architecture and testing conventions.
model.policiesDesc: Stage Policies (pol_...) map each of the 5 SDLC stages to an assigned Agent, configure autonomy, required approvals, minimum approver role, self-approval rules, and cap retries and run timeouts.
model.backendsDesc: Backends connect Git providers, LLM model endpoints, and compute runners. Spend caps and checkpoints pause execution automatically if a Seed approaches its budget.

guide.memberWaitForAdminBackends: An admin needs to connect a Git backend before seeds can run.

runners.queuePolicyDesc: Determines execution ordering of queued seeds awaiting an available runner slot
runners.backendsCallout: Hardware & model rate limits (e.g. local RTX 5090 at 1–2 vs Cloud LiteLLM at 4–8) are configured per-backend.
